author: The Current
description:
Watch Flock of Dimes perform "Hard Way"  in a small music venue in Minneapolis
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Flock of Dimes — the solo project of multi-instrumentalist and producer Jenn Wasner — released her third album, "The Life You Save," on October 10, 2025, on Sub Pop Records.

Wasner visited Minneapolis to perform a MicroShow — a series from The Current that presents live music in intimate or unexpected music venues — to perform songs from the new album as well as a few selections from her back catalogue. The audience in attendance comprised lucky winners who entered for a chance to attend this show.

Thank you to Gertens Garden Center for its support of this MicroShow.

Musicians
Jenn Wasner – vocals and guitar
Alan Good Parker – guitar

Credits
Guests – @flockofdimesofficial 
Host – Gannon 
Producer – Derrick Stevens
Video – Josh Sauvageau
Audio – Maurizio D’Errico
Graphics – Natalia Toledo
Digital Producers – Reed Fischer, Luke
title: Flock of Dimes — Hard Way (Microshow at Cloudland Theater in Minneapolis)

author: The Current
description:
Tommy Brennan of 'Saturday Night Live' looks back on being invited to join the cast
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The news was good but the timing could have been better! St. Paul's Tommy Brennan of "Saturday Night Live" looks back on his audition process for SNL and on the day he got the call inviting him to join the cast. "It all lived up to the hype of how grueling the audition process is," he says in this interview with The Current's Jill Riley.

Host – Jill Riley
Producers – Nilufer Arsala, Derrick Stevens
